comparisons.peer_topic: Shareholder Returns and Stock Repurchase Program
comparisons.peer_summary: AMD returned $862 million to shareholders in 2024 through stock repurchases, with $4.7 billion remaining available under a program that has no termination date and may be suspended or discontinued at any time.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Broadcom disclose their specific stock repurchase activities and remaining authorization levels for fiscal year 2024. While Broadcom had exhausted its entire $20 billion authorization prior to the fiscal year end, AMD continued to have significant capacity remaining under its open-ended program. Broadcom repurchased 67 million shares for $7,176 million in FY2024, whereas AMD repurchased 5.9 million shares for $862 million in the same period. As of year-end, Broadcom had $0 remaining under its specific programs, while AMD had $4.7 billion available for future repurchases.

All $20 billion of the authorized amount under these stock repurchase programs was utilized prior to expiration on December 31, 2023.
During the twelve months ended December 28, 2024, we returned a total of $862 million to shareholders through the repurchase of 5.9 million shares of common stock under our stock repurchase program.
As of December 28, 2024, $4.7 billion remained available for future stock repurchases under this program.

comparisons.peer_topic: Fiscal 2024 Share Repurchase Activity and Authorization
comparisons.peer_summary: In fiscal year 2024, the company repurchased 21 million shares for $9.7 billion, bringing the total remaining authorization to $22.5 billion as of January 28, 2024. The program aims to offset dilution and includes post-year-end repurchases under a Rule 10b5-1 plan, with plans to continue repurchases in the current fiscal year.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies disclose active stock repurchase programs with significant remaining authorization levels and specific repurchase volumes for fiscal year 2024. Broadcom repurchased 67 million shares for $7,176 million in FY2024 under programs that were fully exhausted by the end of that period. Nvidia repurchased 21 million shares for $9.7 billion in fiscal 2024, with a remaining authorization of $22.5 billion as of January 28, 2024, under an open-ended program approved in August 2023. Unlike Broadcom's expired caps, Nvidia's program has no expiration date.
